# Succession Planning Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills > Industry > Wealth Management

## Overview

Use when developing business succession plans for wealth management clients including ownership transfer strategies, buy-sell agreement design, key person planning, and business valuation for succession purposes.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [succession-planning-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
succession-planning-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@succession-planning` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Assess business readiness for ownership transition across management, operations, finances
- Design ownership transfer strategies: internal sale, ESOP, management buyout, third-party sale
- Structure buy-sell agreements with disability, death, retirement, and voluntary triggers
- Perform business valuations using DCF, market multiples, and asset-based approaches

## Industry Standards Applied

- **IRC Section 2703**: Valuation rules for buy-sell agreements for estate tax purposes
- **IRC Section 409A**: Deferred compensation rules affecting succession arrangements
- **Rev. Rul. 59-60**: IRS guidance on valuation of closely-held business interests
